title: Rural Broadband Economics Go Beyond Construction
discussion_signal: The post interprets GAO’s broadband findings as a sustainability problem after construction: defaults, operations, maintenance, and thin rural customer bases can undermine usable service. It proposes cooperative ownership as a counterproposal, adding a local-governance and long-term stewardship frame to the atlas record.
linked_research_question: How does public discussion distinguish broadband construction from sustainable service, and what ownership or governance models are proposed when grant-funded deployment remains fragile?
limits: The cooperative proposal is normative and not an evaluation of outcomes
